summary: Read a lowercase string of length 1 to 104, plus one lowercase letter c that occurs at least once. For every index, find how far it sits from the nearest c: the distance is 0 when that index itself holds c, and otherwise it is the absolute difference of the indexes. Write those shortest distances from left to right as a list of integers.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
